macro rec(n)
   if n==0
      macro(x)
         $x
      end
   else
      let f_rec = $rec($(n-1))
      macro(x)
         run $(print(x))
         $(n * f_rec(x))
      end
   end
end

macro write(...args)
  Positionals args: $Table.join(sep:\,\s, ...List($args))\n
  Named args:\s
  @Table.join(sep:\,\s)
    for key, value in items(args, ?named)
      - $key\=$value
    end
  end
